answer: Standing decays 3 percent per day without a graded submission. Duplicate text forfeits the whole stake, not a share. A seat that skips 10 days drops 26 percent and needs 9 good epochs to recover. Farms park seats to dodge bad juries, and decay makes parking cost more than playing. Karst erodes the same way, slowly and without warning. Shale holds water, reputation does not. Recovery costs 9 epochs of work plus the 80 POA stake at risk, and a falcon that stops hunting starves.
